mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status NOT IN (5, 6) THEN o.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalSales, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_time BETWEEN #{todayStart} AND #{todayEnd} AND o.status NOT IN (5, 6) THEN o.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS todaySales, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_time >= #{todayEnd} - INTERVAL 1 DAY AND o.order_time < #{todayStart} AND o.status NOT IN (5, 6) THEN o.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS yesterdaySales, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_time >= #{weekStart} AND o.order_time <= #{todayEnd} AND o.status NOT IN (5, 6) THEN o.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS weekSales, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_time >= #{monthStart} AND o.order_time <= #{todayEnd} AND o.status NOT IN (5, 6) THEN o.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS monthSales FROM orders o WHERE o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND o.is_deleted = 0

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalOrders, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_time BETWEEN #{todayStart} AND #{todayEnd} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS todayOrders, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_time >= #{weekStart} AND o.order_time <= #{todayEnd} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekOrders, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status IN (1, 2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingOrders, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completedOrders, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelOrders FROM orders o WHERE o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND o.is_deleted = 0

SELECT DATE(o.order_time) AS date, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 4 THEN o.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS revenue FROM orders o WHERE o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND o.is_deleted = 0 AND DATE(o.order_time) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE(o.order_time) ORDER BY DATE(o.order_time) ASC

SELECT d.id AS dishId, d.name AS dishName, c.name AS category, COALESCE(SUM(od.number), 0) AS salesCount, COALESCE(SUM(od.amount), 0) AS revenue FROM order_detail od INNER JOIN orders o ON o.id = od.order_id INNER JOIN dish d ON d.id = od.dish_id LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = d.category_id WHERE od.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND od.is_deleted = 0 AND o.is_deleted = 0 AND d.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY od.dish_id, d.name, c.name ORDER BY salesCount DESC, revenue DESC LIMIT #{limit}
